action: Participate in Linda Park's one-on-one meeting. Give her honest, specific field intelligence about customer cancellations — the real reasons clients are leaving: they sold their cars, switched to RoboRide, or couldn't justify the premium when they're barely driving. Frame it professionally as data, not despair. In exchange, probe Linda for what AutoShield's regional strategy is: are they pivoting to new product lines, are there internal transfers available, is there a corporate retraining program? Listen more than I talk. Take mental notes on whether she seems like she has a plan or whether she's just gathering data to manage upward.
